svg.title: Alex Josue Ynocencio Callirgos: fastfetch on Arch Linux with i3
svg.desc: An i3 desktop. A terminal runs fastfetch: a dot portrait that rearranges itself into the Arch Linux logo and back, and system lines for a systems engineering student with 15 public repositories and 161 contributions. A second window plots the last 52 weeks of activity.
